title: Harness Benchmark Result
description: One record per (test scenario x variant x model) run of the BENCHMARK_SOP scenarios. Evidence over claims: every record must point at a real session log.

id.description: Short content hash of the evidence log, so results are traceable.

variant.description: Vanilla = no skills loaded. Harness = full skill set loaded.

outcome.description: pass = expected behavioral difference observed; fail = agent behaved like vanilla.

evidence.description: Path to the exported conversation log relative to benchmarks/results/.
